panels.title: Matching active listings
panels.description: Distinct current ads matching every result filter; current means open and seen within 14 days.

targets.rawSql:
WITH validation AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price') AS min_price_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking price per m²') AS min_rate_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area') AS min_area_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100) AS min_score_ok
),
market AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.*
    FROM reporting.current_listing_scores s
    CROSS JOIN validation
   WHERE s.deal = 'sale'
    AND COALESCE(s.property_type, 'unknown') = ${property_type:sqlstring}
    AND ((ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__mapped__'] AND s.neighborhood IS NOT NULL)
         OR COALESCE(s.neighborhood, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
         OR COALESCE(s.room_bucket, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]))
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.sqm, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area')
    AND (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.condition::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.parking::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${garage:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.garage::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${garage:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${elevator:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.elevator::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${elevator:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${floor:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.floor_num::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${floor:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.seller_type::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}]))
),
matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.* FROM market s
   WHERE reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_price, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_rate, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking price per m²')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.score, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100)
    AND CASE ${listing_selection:sqlstring}
          WHEN 'new' THEN s.first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
          WHEN 'reduced' THEN s.latest_reduction_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
          WHEN 'below' THEN s.deviation_pct < -5
          ELSE TRUE
        END
    
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS matches FROM matches

  SELECT reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price') AS min_price_ok,

    AND (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.seller_type::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}]))
),
matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.* FROM market s
   WHERE reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_price, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_rate, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking price per m²')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.score, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100)
    AND CASE ${listing_selection:sqlstring}
          WHEN 'new' THEN s.first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
          WHEN 'reduced' THEN s.latest_reduction_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
          WHEN 'below' THEN s.deviation_pct < -5
          ELSE TRUE
        END
    
)
SELECT COALESCE(neighborhood, 'unknown') AS neighbourhood,
       count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS "active listings",
       count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_price IS NOT NULL)::int AS "eligible total-price sample",
       count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL)::int AS "eligible rate sample",
       CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL) >= 10
            THEN round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL)) END AS "median asking rate",
       CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL) >= 10
            THEN round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL)) END AS "p25 asking rate",
       CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL) >= 10
            THEN round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE asking_rate IS NOT NULL)) END AS "p75 asking rate",
       CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE asking_price IS NOT NULL) >= 10
            THEN round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_price) FILTER (WHERE asking_price IS NOT NULL)) END AS "median total asking price",
       
       count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (
         WHERE asking_price IS NOT NULL
           AND (reporting.numeric_bound(${min_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price') IS NULL OR asking_price >= reporting.numeric_bound(${min_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price'))
           AND (reporting.numeric_bound(${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price') IS NULL OR asking_price <= reporting.numeric_bound(${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price'))
       )::int AS "within price range",
       count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE score IS NOT NULL)::int AS "scorable count"
  FROM market
 GROUP BY neighborhood
 ORDER BY "median asking rate" DESC NULLS LAST, neighbourhood

    AND (ARRAY[${elevator:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.elevator::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${elevator:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${floor:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.floor_num::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${floor:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
          OR COALESCE(s.seller_type::text, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}]))
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_price, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.asking_rate, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking price per m²')
    AND reporting.within_bounds(s.score, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100)
    AND CASE ${listing_selection:sqlstring}
          WHEN 'new' THEN s.first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
          WHEN 'reduced' THEN s.latest_reduction_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
          WHEN 'below' THEN s.deviation_pct < -5
          ELSE TRUE
        END
    
)
SELECT article_id, title, url, COALESCE(neighborhood, 'unknown') AS neighbourhood,
       deal, property_type, asking_price AS "asking price KM", sqm AS "area m²",
       asking_rate AS "asking rate KM/m²", room_bucket AS rooms,
       benchmark_rate AS "local benchmark", round(deviation_pct, 1) AS "deviation %",
       score, comparable_count AS comparables, confidence, seller_type,
       first_seen, last_seen, current_cycle_age_days AS "observed cycle days",
       reduction_km AS "latest reduction KM", round(reduction_pct, 1) AS "reduction %",
       concat_ws(' · ',
         CASE WHEN deviation_pct < -10 THEN concat(round(abs(deviation_pct)), '% below comparable local asks')
              WHEN deviation_pct < -5 THEN 'Below comparable local asks' END,
         CASE WHEN first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN concat('First observed ', greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - first_seen)) / 86400))::int, ' days ago') END,
         CASE WHEN latest_reduction_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN concat('Reduced ', trim(to_char(abs(reduction_km), 'FM999G999G999')), ' KM') END,
         CASE WHEN reopened THEN 'Reopened' END,
         CASE WHEN score IS NULL THEN unscored_reason END
       ) AS reasons
  FROM scoped
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN ${sort:sqlstring} = 'lowest_price' THEN asking_price END ASC NULLS LAST,
       CASE WHEN ${sort:sqlstring} = 'lowest_rate' THEN asking_rate END ASC NULLS LAST,
       CASE WHEN ${sort:sqlstring} = 'newest' THEN first_seen END DESC NULLS LAST,
       CASE WHEN ${sort:sqlstring} = 'largest_reduction' THEN reduction_km END DESC NULLS LAST,
       score DESC NULLS LAST, first_seen DESC NULLS LAST, article_id
 LIMIT 25
 OFFSET (greatest(reporting.numeric_bound(${page:sqlstring}, 'result page', 20)::int, 1) - 1) * 25

panels.title: Neighbourhood asking-price trend — market context before price filters
panels.description: Daily neighbourhood P25, median and P75 asking KM/m² from historical evidence, with eligible sample and provisional, inferred and stale quality fields.

targets.rawSql:
WITH validation AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_price:sqlstring}, ${max_price:sqlstring}, 'asking price') AS min_price_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_rate:sqlstring}, ${max_rate:sqlstring}, 'asking price per m²') AS min_rate_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area') AS min_area_ok,
         reporting.within_bounds(NULL::numeric, ${min_score:sqlstring}, ${max_score:sqlstring}, 'score', 100) AS min_score_ok
)
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       CASE WHEN d.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR d.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE d.neighborhood END AS neighbourhood,
       
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) >= 10
            THEN percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) END AS "p25 asking rate",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) >= 10
            THEN percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) END AS "median asking rate",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) >= 10
            THEN percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible) END AS "p75 asking rate",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE rate_eligible)::int AS "rate sample",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE membership_inferred OR attributes_inferred)::int AS inferred,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stale_observation)::int AS stale,
       bool_or(provisional_day) AS provisional
  FROM reporting.daily_listing_facts d CROSS JOIN validation
 WHERE d.day >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date
                    - reporting.numeric_bound(${history_days:sqlstring}, 'history window', 90)::int
    AND d.day <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date
    AND d.deal = 'sale'
    AND COALESCE(d.property_type, 'unknown') = ${property_type:sqlstring}
    AND ((ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__mapped__'] AND CASE WHEN d.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR d.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE d.neighborhood END <> 'unknown')
         OR CASE WHEN d.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR d.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE d.neighborhood END = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
         OR COALESCE(d.room_bucket, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${rooms:sqlstring}]))
    AND reporting.within_bounds(d.sqm, ${min_area:sqlstring}, ${max_area:sqlstring}, 'area')
    AND (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(d.historical_condition, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${condition:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(COALESCE(d.historical_attributes->>'parking', d.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'parking'), 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${parking:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${garage:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(COALESCE(d.historical_attributes->>'garage', d.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'garage'), 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${garage:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${elevator:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(COALESCE(d.historical_attributes->>'elevator', d.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'elevator'), 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${elevator:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${floor:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(COALESCE(d.historical_attributes->>'floorNum', d.historical_attributes->'searchAttributes'->>'floorNum'), 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${floor:sqlstring}]))
    AND (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}] @> ARRAY['__any__']
      OR COALESCE(d.historical_seller_type, 'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${seller_type:sqlstring}]))
 GROUP BY day, CASE WHEN d.neighborhood IS NULL
                 OR d.neighborhood IN ('(no pin)', '(unmapped)', 'unknown')
              THEN 'unknown' ELSE d.neighborhood END
 ORDER BY day, neighbourhood

panels.title: Exact scoring comparables
panels.description: Same-statement subject and exact cohort snapshot. The target is excluded. Cohort count, P25, median, P75, indicative totals, benchmark version and evaluation timestamp repeat for inspection; benchmark-derived values are withheld below 10 comparables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH subject AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.* FROM reporting.current_listing_scores s
   WHERE s.article_id = reporting.numeric_bound(${subject_id:sqlstring}, 'subject article ID')
     AND s.deal = 'sale'
),
cohort AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.*
    FROM subject s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL reporting.listing_comparables(s.article_id) c
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT count(*)::int AS "cohort count",
         percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) AS raw_p25,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) AS raw_median,
         percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY asking_rate) AS raw_p75
    FROM cohort
)
SELECT c.article_id, c.title, c.url, COALESCE(c.neighborhood, 'unknown') AS neighbourhood,
       c.sqm AS "area m²", c.room_bucket AS rooms, c.asking_price AS "asking price KM",
       c.asking_rate AS "asking rate KM/m²", c.last_seen,
       CASE WHEN c.furnished IS TRUE THEN 'furnished' WHEN c.furnished IS FALSE THEN 'unfurnished' ELSE 'unknown' END AS furnishing,
       b."cohort count", CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_p25 END AS "cohort p25",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_median END AS "cohort median",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_p75 END AS "cohort p75",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_p25 * s.sqm END AS "indicative low",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_median * s.sqm END AS "indicative total",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN b.raw_p75 * s.sqm END AS "indicative high",
       CASE WHEN b."cohort count" >= 10 THEN s.asking_price - b.raw_median * s.sqm END AS "asking gap",
       s.benchmark_at AS "evaluated at", s.score_version AS version
  FROM subject s CROSS JOIN benchmark b LEFT JOIN cohort c ON true
 ORDER BY c.asking_rate, c.article_id

panels.title: Current-cycle asking-price history
panels.description: Valid same-currency, same-deal changes in the current observed cycle. Invalid boundaries, deal switches and reopenings prevent false continuity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.effective_at, c.prior_price AS "prior asking price KM",
       c.price AS "new asking price KM", c.delta AS "change KM",
       round(c.pct_change, 1) AS "change %"
  FROM reporting.comparison_price_changes c
  JOIN reporting.current_listing_scores s USING (article_id)
 WHERE c.article_id = reporting.numeric_bound(${subject_id:sqlstring}, 'subject article ID')
   AND s.deal = 'sale'
 ORDER BY c.effective_at
